A Journey Through Time

The Evolution of AI

From Turing's visionary ideas to today's generative revolution — trace the milestones that shaped artificial intelligence.

1950

The Turing Test

Alan Turing proposes the famous "Imitation Game" — a test of machine intelligence that still influences AI research today.

1956

Birth of AI

The Dartmouth Conference coins the term "Artificial Intelligence" and establishes it as a formal field of study.

1980s

Expert Systems

Rule-based AI systems gain commercial traction, encoding human expertise into decision-making programs.

1997

Deep Blue

IBM's Deep Blue defeats world chess champion Garry Kasparov — a landmark moment for machine intelligence.

2012

Deep Learning Revolution

AlexNet wins ImageNet by a huge margin, sparking the modern deep learning revolution and the AI boom.

2016

AlphaGo

DeepMind's AlphaGo defeats the world Go champion Lee Sedol — a game thought to be decades away from AI mastery.

2020

GPT-3

OpenAI releases GPT-3, demonstrating unprecedented language understanding and generation capabilities.

2022

Generative AI Era

ChatGPT, DALL-E, and Stable Diffusion bring AI creativity to the mainstream, transforming how we work and create.

2024+

Multimodal AI

AI systems that understand text, images, audio, and video simultaneously — approaching human-like perception.

What Does the Future Hold?

The next chapter of AI is being written right now. Peek into what lies ahead.
